augments.name: Pandora's Bench
augments.description: At the start of every round, champions on the 3 rightmost bench slots transform into random champions of the same cost. Gain 6 gold.

augments.name: Pandora's Items II
augments.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 2 random components.

augments.name: Pandora's Items III
augments.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 1 random Radiant item.

augments.name: Pilfer
augments.description: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain 35 gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves. TFT_Augment_Template_Blank TFT_Augment_Template_Blank

augments.name: Placebo
augments.description: Your team gains 1% Attack Speed. Gain 8 gold.

augments.name: Plot Armor
augments.description: Your team gains 8 Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below 50% Health, increase this to 40 for the rest of combat.

augments.name: Portable Forge
augments.description: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny
augments.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 4 gold.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny+
augments.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 10 gold.

augments.name: Prizefighter
augments.description: Gain 2 item components. Every 5 wins gives you an item component.

augments.name: Pyromaniac
augments.description: Gain a Red Buff. Your Burns deal 50% increased damage.

augments.name: Radiant Rascal
augments.description: Gain a Rascal's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round. Radiant items are very powerful versions of completed items.

augments.name: Radiant Relics
augments.description: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant items. Gain a Magnetic Remover. Radiant items are very powerful versions of completed items.

augments.name: Raining Gold
augments.description: Gain 7 gold now and 1 gold every round.

augments.name: Replication
augments.description: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next 2 rounds, gain a copy of that component.

augments.name: Retribution
augments.description: Gain 2 Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice can critically strike with their Abilities.

augments.name: Risky Moves
augments.description: Your Tactician loses 20 Health, but after 7 player combats, gain 30 gold.

augments.name: Salvage Bin+
augments.description: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 4 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

augments.name: Savings Account
augments.description: After you earn 50 gold in interest, gain 30 gold. Your max interest is increased to 7. Gain 4 gold now. Gold earned: Varies

augments.name: Sentinels of Light
augments.description: Gain a Lucian & Senna and a 2-star Vayne. Vayne fires additional bolts at enemies afflicted with Black Mist and on takedown, grants Attack Speed to Lucian & Senna.

augments.name: Shimmerscale Essence
augments.description: Gain a Mogul's Mail. In 5 rounds, gain a Gamblers Blade. These items give gold as well as combat power.

augments.name: Silco's Revenge
augments.description: Zaunites explode into Shimmer on death, dealing 30% of their max Health to 2 nearby enemies as magic damage. Gain a Blitzcrank, an Ekko, and a Vi.

augments.name: Silver Destiny
augments.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 2 gold.

augments.name: Silver Destiny+
augments.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 4 gold.

augments.name: Slice of Life
augments.description: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving 1 5-cost champion.

augments.name: Solo Leveling
augments.description: For the next 5 combats, your team size is 1 but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain 1 XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain 2 item components.

augments.name: Solo Plate
augments.description: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Combat start: Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain 15% max Health if they're the only one in their row.

augments.name: Spear's Will
augments.description: Your team gains 12% Attack Damage and 5 Mana. Gain a B.F. Sword.

augments.name: Sword Overflow
augments.description: Gain 4 B.F. Swords. Your B.F. Swords grant +5% Attack Speed.

augments.name: Team Building
augments.description: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after 5 player combats. This item allows you to copy a 3-cost or less champion.

augments.name: Teaming Up
augments.description: Gain 1 random component and 2 random 3-cost champions.

augments.name: The Golden Dragon
augments.description: Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up 2 team slots but gain 700 Health and 20% Durability. Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power. Dragonlands Championship, 2022

augments.name: Thorn-Plated Armor
augments.description: Gain a Bramble Vest. Your Bramble Vests deal 20-170% more damage (based on Stage).

augments.name: Tiny, but Deadly
augments.description: Your team becomes small, gaining 30% Attack Speed and Movement Speed.

augments.name: Tons of Stats!
augments.description: Your team gains 44 Health, 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 4 Armor, 4 Magic Resist, 4% Attack Speed, and 4 Mana.

augments.name: Trade Sector
augments.description: Gain a free Shop reroll every round. Gain 4 gold.

augments.name: Treasure Hunt
augments.description: Gain a locked chest each Stage between now and Stage 6. Unlock each chest when you spend 20 gold on Shop rerolls. These chests persist until opened.

augments.name: Two Trick
augments.description: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost and 2 random 2-star 1-cost champions.

augments.name: U.R.F
augments.description: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain 15% Attack Speed and 2 Mana Regen.

augments.name: Urf's Gambit
augments.description: If you win your next player combat, gain a Spatula. If you lose, gain a Frying Pan. Gain a component anvil and 6 gold now.

augments.name: Wand Overflow
augments.description: Gain 4 Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +5% Attack Speed.

augments.name: We Stick Together
augments.description: Gain a random Emblem and a completed item anvil. Allies that share a trait with that Emblem gain 20% Attack Speed. (Emblem Trait: TFT_Augment_WeStickTogether_Blank) Into The Arcane Tactician's Crown, 2025

augments.name: Win Out
augments.description: When you reach level 9, immediately level to 10 and gain 2 free Shop rerolls. Gain 6 XP now.

augments.name: Worth the Wait
augments.description: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game. Champion: Varies

augments.name: Woven Magic
augments.description: Gain a random item component. Every 2200 Mana your team spends grants an additional component (max Varies/3). Mana spent: Varies/2200

augments.name: Augmented Power
augments.description: Your next augment is one tier higher.

augments.name: Big Friend I
augments.description: Allies that start combat next to an ally with over 1750 Health gain 10% Durability.

augments.name: Binary Airdrop
augments.description: Combat start: Champions holding 2 items gain a random 3rd completed item. Gain 2 random component now.

augments.name: Called Shot
augments.description: Set your win streak to 4. Gain 4 gold.

augments.name: Celestial Blessing III
augments.description: Your team gains 25% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 1000 Health.

augments.name: Chaos Magic
augments.description: Arcanists gain 1 Mana Regen. After every 150 Mana they spend, a magical effect hits the board. Gain a Neeko and an Ahri.

augments.name: Chaotic Evolution
augments.description: Starring up a champion grants them one of the following: 100 Health, 6% Durability, 10% Ability Power, 10% Attack Damage, 10% Attack Speed. Bonuses stack.

augments.name: Clear Mind
augments.description: If there are no champions on your bench at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

augments.name: Component Heist
augments.description: After 4 player combats, gain 1 of every item component. TFT_Augment_Template_Blank TFT_Augment_Template_Blank

augments.name: Construct a Companion
augments.description: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3 star. Gain 2 gold.

augments.name: Crafted Crafting
augments.description: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain 2 rerolls.

augments.name: Critical Success
augments.description: Gain a Sparring Glove. After your team's attacks critically strike 320 times, gain 2 more. Critical strikes: Varies

augments.name: Cry Me A River
augments.description: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. After 12 seconds in combat, increase this to 3.

augments.name: Darkwill's Invasion
augments.description: Your team gains 10% Damage Amp, increased to 15% if the Noxus trait is active.

augments.name: Defense of the Placidium
augments.description: Your team gains 8% Durability, increased to 12% if the Ionia trait is active.

augments.name: Efficient Shopper
augments.description: For the next 4 carousels, gain a second copy of the champion taken.

augments.name: Find Your Center
augments.description: Your champion that starts combat in the center of the front row gains 15% Damage Amp and 15% max Health.

augments.name: Focused Fire
augments.description: Your team gains 5% Attack Damage. Every 5 seconds, they gain 5% more.

augments.name: Hefty Rolls
augments.description: Your team gains 9 Health and size for each time you've rolled this game. Rolls: Varies Health: Varies

augments.name: Hexgate Travel
augments.description: When the Piltover invention triggers for the first time each combat, gain a random number of Piltover champions that cost between 1 and 3 gold. Gain a Caitlyn and a Vi.

augments.name: Indiscriminate Killer
augments.description: Gain a Giant Slayer. Giant Slayers gain their Damage Amp against all enemies instead of just Tanks.

augments.name: Kahunahuna
augments.description: Every 5th attack deals bonus true damage equal to 200% Basic Attack Damage.

augments.name: Luxury Subscription
augments.description: Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and 5 gold. At the start of the next 2 stages, gain the package again.

augments.name: NO SCOUT NO PIVOT
augments.description: Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your team gains 1% Health, and 1.5% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat. tft10_headliner_default

augments.name: Poison Pals
augments.description: Gain a 2-star Teemo. Singed's damage refreshes Teemo's poisons, and every 100 magic damage Teemo deals grants your strongest Singed 2% Ability Power. Gain a Teemo after each player combat.

augments.name: Preparation I
augments.description: Champions on your bench permanently gain 30 Health, 3% Attack Damage, and 3% Ability Power every round. Champions start with 1 stack of this effect, and can stack up to 4 times.

augments.name: Preparation II
augments.description: Champions on your bench permanently gain 50 Health, 4% Attack Damage, and 4% Ability Power every round. Champions start with 1 stack of this effect, and can stack up to 4 times.

augments.name: Promised Protection
augments.description: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder 18% additional Mana from all sources.

augments.name: Recombobulator
augments.description: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Gain 2 Magnetic Removers.

augments.name: Secrets of the Sands
augments.description: Gain 6 gold. Gain an Azir on Stage 3-5. Each time you unlock a Shuriman, gain an ideal item for them.

augments.name: Spoils of War I
augments.description: Enemies have a 25% chance to drop loot when killed.

augments.name: Spoils of War II
augments.description: Enemies have a 30% chance to drop loot when killed.

augments.name: Starter Kit
augments.description: Gain a 4-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion that shares a trait with them, and 8 gold. At the start of the next 2 stages, gain that 4-cost champion again.

augments.name: The Axiomata
augments.description: Gain 3 random elemental hex augments. Future augment rounds instead grant you items and gold based on the augment's tier.

augments.name: The Golden Egg
augments.description: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

augments.name: Trifecta I
augments.description: Gain 2 3-cost champions. Combat Start: 3 random 3-cost champions gain 220 Health and 20% Attack Speed.

augments.name: Trifecta II
augments.description: Gain 3 3-cost champions. Allies gain 5% Attack Speed. Combat Start: 3 random 3-cost champions gain 300 Health and 25% Attack Speed.

augments.name: Walk The True Path I
augments.description: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator, a Shen, a Jhin, and 6 gold. Ionia 10 gains a Prismatic upgrade.

augments.name: Walk The True Path II
augments.description: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators, a Jhin, a Shen, and an Infinity Edge. Ionia 10 gains a Prismatic upgrade.

augments.name: Warlord's Honor
augments.description: Every round, your team gain 5% Attack Damage and Ability Power, stacking up to 4 times.

augments.name: Warpath
augments.description: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing 80 player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items. (Current: Varies)

augments.name: Wild Growth
augments.description: 3-star Yordles become massive, moving slower but gaining 15% Health and 35% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Gain a Rumble and Lulu.

augments.name: Wood Axiom
augments.description: Gain a Wood Hex. Champions within gain 15% max Health. After combat, they permanently gain 40 Health.

augments.name: Worth the Wait II
augments.description: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game. Champion: Varies

augments.name: Lunch Money
augments.description: Every 7 damage you deal to enemy tacticians gives you 2 gold. Total Payouts: Varies Gold

augments.name: Spoils of War III
augments.description: Enemies have a 45% chance to drop loot when killed.

augments.name: Survivor
augments.description: Gain 4 gold. After 3 players are eliminated, gain 100 more gold.

augments.name: Twin Guardians
augments.description: If you have exactly 2 allies in your first row, grant them 50 Armor and 50 Magic Resist.
